newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Emery Worldwide opens Taiwan offices.
newsitem.headline: Emery Worldwide opens Taiwan offices.

text.p: Emery Worldwide, a unit of CNF Transportation Inc, said on Wednesday it was opening offices in Taipei and Kaoshiung in Taiwan to offer international air cargo services, customs brokerage and local bonded warehousing.
"The new branches are part of Emery's goal to establish a stronger presence throughout the north Asia region," said Cyril Rodrigo, Emery's vice president for the Asia Pacific Area.
The robust economy in Taiwan and in the Asia Pacific provided excellent growth opportunities to the company, he said in a statement.
